value.summary: Adds a new `summarise` module with two public functions (`shorten`, `first_sentence`) and unit tests. Both functions handle edge cases (short text, multibyte characters, no delimiter), and the tests exercise those cases. No security-sensitive operations, no untrusted input misuse (model-authored text is already in-memory), no dependency changes, no network or subprocess calls, no deserialization, no path traversal, no credential exposure. Looks safe to merge.
